ADMISSION PROCESS  
 
First Year of B. Tech (A. Y. 2025 - 26) 
 
The Admission Process will be carried out as per directives/guidelines published by State 
Common Entrance Test Cell, Government of Maharashtra, Mumbai.  Please read the 
Information Brochure, Admission Notice and Admission Process Document carefully 
before seeking admission to the College. 
After getting allotment, secure your Admission as per following steps 
 
01. Freeze your allotment and take print of “Confirmation of Seat Acceptance Report ''. 
02. Download and fill up the Admission Form uploaded on MES MLCOE Website. Bring 
the duly filled-in Admission Form, all the required and available original documents and 
three sets of Xerox Copies of all original documents in A4 size, at the time of reporting. 
03. The Adhoc Fees Structure approved by Fees Regulating Authority (FRA), 
Maharashtra State is as follows.

Pay the Fees as per your respective category after document verification in the College 
during CAP Round Reporting. 
Available Mode of payment of fees: UPI / Demand Draft / Pay Order / Cheque / NEFT 
/ RTGS etc.  The Demand Draft/Pay Order/Cheque shall be drawn in favor of “MES 
Mukunddas Lohia College of Engineering”, payable at Pune. 
 
04. Report to MES IMCC Institute (Click for Google Map link) for Admission and:- 
a) Deposit all ORIGINAL document/s along with 02 sets of Xerox copies in A4 size 
only. 
b) Collect Receipt of confirmation of admission and  
c) Join the FE Admission WhatsApp Group by scanning the QR Code for further 
important communication with the College.
